references.text: Eglon was one of the five Amorite kings who formed a coalition against Gibeon and were defeated by Joshua at Gibeon.
Eglon is mentioned as one of the kings who were captured in the cave at Makkedah after the defeat.
King Horam of Gezer came to help Lachish but was struck down by Joshua along with his people.
Joshua conquered Eglon and struck it with the edge of the sword, just as he had done with Lachish.
Gezer is mentioned as a city where the Canaanites were not driven out but lived among the Ephraimites.
Gezer was later given to Solomon by Pharaoh as a dowry when he married Pharaoh's daughter.
The Ephraimites did not drive out the Canaanites living in Gezer, so the Canaanites continued to live there.
Eglon, king of Moab, oppressed Israel for eighteen years until Ehud killed him.
